findings.finding: Native Core818 supplies Action,60ft cast range,Instantaneous,V/S/F,base26RP; full60ft-radius lift60ft then falling promise. One Transmutation placement with Druid/Mage/Wizard rank9 class17 access. It gives no crate material,structuralHP,impact breakage or tether force law. Native card remains unchanged.

Current Sunder and cargo rules require the actual item durability/capacity/attachment; they explicitly leave unspecified durability dependent. Source establishes the dependency, not the missing crate values.

Conjure Rope does provide a real50ft10lb AC11HP5 rope with300lb total STATIC-load support and a real load-bearing anchor. It supplies neither the zero-length tether fixture nor its anchor rating nor a rule translating the proposed upward lift into that load. Not treated as absent rope content and not silently installed as a replacement.

Hunting trap3ft tether, sound Climber-kit anchor/25ftfall catch, and block/tackle4x ordinary lifting are limited contracts. None certifies this zero-length upward restraint; object/tether durability beyond printed nets remains open.

Known20lb mass and5x5x5ft fixture volume are not material/structuralHP/breakage rules. Quality multiplier requires existing explicit structuralHP; cannot supply an unknown maximum. No conversion from creatureHP, Load or another object profile.

Creature Falling has source-relative fixed markers and20ft/d6 descent formula. This preserves60ft3d6,120ft6d6 and real Feather Fall Action; it does not independently give the crate a structural-damage,fracture or salvage contract.

Selected conditional Wizard17 class cards/acquisition levels match current source; maxRP64 and base26RP paid once per valid gravity cast. A conditional actor build is not certification of a campaign individual or unprovided equipment.

scopeDecision: Both required positive main cases include objects, with B including real obstruction/attachment. Creature-only numerical success does not satisfy the broad native everything promise or exact positive object/attachment obligations. Preserve passing components and narrow incomplete branches; the identity remains held until required integrated witnesses exist. No automatic carry-forward or new physical values authorized.
